My plot is small, only a third of a hectare, and I mainly grow beans with other crops mixed in. Here in Kilimanjaro we have good soil from the mountain, and beans fix their own nitrogen, so I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot — it is expensive and I save that for when I grow maize. I put manure from my animals on the plot before planting, and I use the seeds I saved from last season, which do well in my field. I work this plot myself with my hoe; my children help sometimes but I do not have money to hire people for such a small piece of land.
